import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n = int(data[0])
s = data[1]

max_length = 0
count = 0
prefix_sum = {0: -1}

for i in range(n):
    count += 1 if s[i] == "1" else -1
    if count in prefix_sum:
        max_length = max(max_length, i - prefix_sum[count])
    else:
        prefix_sum[count] = i

print(max_length)
